build_symmetric_binding_program: build a symmetric binding protein program with configurable IL-10 binding sites using ProgramNode
create_protomer_with_energy_terms: create a protomer program node with surface exposure and RMSD energy function terms
fetch_pdb_binding_site_atoms: fetch PDB structure 1y6k and extract binding site atoms in residue range 31-40
configure_sequence_segments: configure leader and follower amino acid sequence segments with fixed length of 45 residues
optimize_symmetric_complex: optimize a symmetric protein complex using PTM, pLDDT, symmetry ring, and surface hydrophobics terms
